description: Use this app to create my app and make it so the weekly routine repeat itself every week and put more variations: https://routine-ascension.lovable.app/

designManifest.iconDirection: A flat emblem mark: a glowing cyan-indigo holographic gate/window glyph with cut corner brackets on a near-black void ground, evoking a System status panel — geometric, sharp, sci-fi.
designManifest.signatureMove: Angular 'system window' panels with cut clip-path corners, cyan corner-bracket marks and a glow, used everywhere alongside an XP bar, hexagonal rank badge and an animated 'Quête complétée' notification overlay on completion.
designManifest.summary: The interface treats the visitor as a Hunter just awakened by The System, presenting every workout as a holographic blue status-window quest with corner brackets, scan glow and an XP/rank ladder.
designManifest.typography: Orbitron (HUD/system display headings) paired with Rajdhani (condensed humanist sans for body and UI)

promptHistory.prompt: Use this app to create my app and make it so the weekly routine repeat itself every week and put more variations: https://routine-ascension.lovable.app/
promptHistory.changeNotes:
Built ASCENSION, a Solo Leveling-inspired French training PWA. The weekly routine is fixed (7 days/quests) and repeats every week, but each training day now carries multiple rotating protocols (Alpha/Bêta/Gamma) that the System auto-selects per week so the workout never repeats identically. Includes per-user XP, levels, E→S ranks and streaks, full quest-completion round-trip, a Journal, a contact form, and a complete admin backend for managing days, exercises and posts.

Admin enrichment: (1) Added a full Settings admin page (views/admin-settings.ejs + public/js/admin-settings.js) that lets the owner edit site texts (slogan, hero subtitle, about text, business name), contact email/phone, and hero/about images (with upload + AI generation) via the existing /api/admin/settings endpoint. (2) Added a dedicated Messages page (views/admin-submissions.ejs) reading /api/admin/submissions with readable message cards. (3) Sidebar now includes Réglages + Messages links with active states. (4) Dashboard rebuilt: richer stat cards (now includes Messages count + completions), restructured quick-links with label/count, and a 'Tous les messages' link. (5) admin.js upgraded: non-blocking toast notifications replace alert(), a live search box + per-select-field filter bar (filter exercises by day & variation, posts by category) with a result counter, image thumbnail column, on/off badges for boolean columns, save-button busy state, clearer confirm + empty states. All existing CRUD (create/edit/delete) for posts, routine_days, exercises preserved and still fully functional from each module page. (6) admin-styles.css extended with toast, filter bar, thumbnail, badge, settings, submissions, hover and focus-visible styles for accessibility. (7) styles.css gained a focus-visible outline rule for keyboard accessibility. No functional data flows, routes, schema, seed data or {{IMG_*}} placeholders were altered; functional offering data (routine days, exercises with XP/rest/sets, base XP) remains admin-managed as before.
